title: The Book of 2 Kings Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 Kings — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
verses.decoded: After Ahab died, Moab rebelled against Israel.

verses.kjv: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
verses.decoded: And Ahaziah fell through a lattice in his upper room in Samaria and became sick. He sent messengers and said to them, Go, ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, if I will recover from this illness.

verses.kjv: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?
verses.decoded: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Get up, go to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say to them, Is it not because there is no God in Israel that you are going to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?

verses.kjv: Now therefore thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.
verses.decoded: So now the LORD says, You will not get down from the bed you have gone up to, but you will definitely die. Then Elijah left.

verses.kjv: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
verses.decoded: And when the messengers returned to him, he said to them, Why have you now come back?

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
verses.decoded: And they said to him, A man came to meet us and said to us, Go back to the king who sent you and tell him, This is what the LORD says, Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore, you will not get off the bed you have gone up to, but you will surely die.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
verses.decoded: And he said to them, What kind of man was the one who came to meet you and told you these words?

verses.kjv: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.
verses.decoded: And they answered him, He was a hairy man, wearing a leather belt around his waist. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

verses.kjv: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.
verses.decoded: Then the king sent a captain of fifty soldiers with his fifty men to him. The captain went up to him, and he was sitting on the top of a hill. The captain said to him, 'You man of God, the king has said, Come down.'

verses.kjv: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.decoded: Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven and destroy you and your fifty men. Then fire came down from heaven and destroyed him and his fifty men.

verses.kjv: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
verses.decoded: Again he sent another captain of fifty soldiers with his fifty men to him. The man of God answered and said to him, "O man of God, this is what the king has said: Come down quickly."

verses.kjv: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.decoded: And Elijah answered and said to them, If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven and consumed him and his fifty.

verses.kjv: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
verses.decoded: He sent a captain of the third group of fifty soldiers with his fifty men. The third captain of fifty went up, came, and knelt before Elijah, begged him, and said, 'O man of God, please, let my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours be valuable in your eyes.'

verses.kjv: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.
verses.decoded: Look, fire came down from heaven and burned up the two commanders of the first fifties along with their fifty men; so now let my life be valuable in your eyes.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the Lord said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
verses.decoded: And the angel of the LORD said to Elijah, Go down with him; do not be afraid of him. So he got up and went down with him to the king.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, This is what the LORD says: Because you have sent messengers to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to ask for guidance? Therefore, you will not get off the bed you have gone up on; you will certainly die there.

verses.kjv: So he died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
verses.decoded: So he died as the LORD had said through Elijah. Then Jehoram became king in his place in the second year of Jehoram, the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, because he had no son.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other things that Ahaziah did, are they not written in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the Lord would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the LORD was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah left Gilgal with Elisha.

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Beth-el. And Elisha said unto him, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Beth-el.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said to Elisha, Please stay here; because the LORD has sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said to him, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they went down to Bethel.

verses.kjv: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Lord will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
verses.decoded: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?" And he said, "Yes, I know it; be quiet."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
verses.decoded: And Elijah said to him, Elisha, stay here, please; because the LORD has sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they went to Jericho.

verses.kjv: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Lord will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
verses.decoded: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came to Elisha and said to him, "Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today?" He answered, "Yes, I know it; be quiet."

verses.kjv: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the Lord hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
verses.decoded: Elijah said to him, Please stay here; because the LORD has sent me to the Jordan. And he said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So the two of them went on.

verses.kjv: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
verses.decoded: Fifty men from the group of prophets went and stood watching from a distance, while the two of them stood by the Jordan River.

verses.kjv: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
verses.decoded: Elijah took his cloak, folded it up, and struck the water, and the water split apart, so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
verses.decoded: After they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, 'Ask what I should do for you before I am taken away from you.' Elisha replied, 'Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.
verses.decoded: And he said, You have asked for something difficult: however, if you see me when I am taken away from you, it will be granted to you; but if you do not, it will not be granted.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.decoded: As they continued walking and talking, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and separated them; then Elijah was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind.

verses.kjv: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
verses.decoded: Elisha saw this and shouted, 'My father, my father, the chariot of Israel and its horsemen!' Then he did not see him anymore. Elisha grabbed his own clothes and tore them into two pieces.

verses.kjv: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
verses.decoded: He also picked up the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him, then returned and stood by the bank of the Jordan River;

verses.kjv: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the Lord God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
verses.decoded: He picked up the cloak that Elijah had dropped, struck the water, and said, 'Where is the LORD God of Elijah?' When he struck the water, it split apart to the right and left, and Elisha crossed over.

verses.kjv: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
verses.decoded: When the sons of the prophets who were watching at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha. They came to meet him and bowed down to the ground before him.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the Lord hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
verses.decoded: And they said to him, Look now, there are with your servants fifty strong men; please let them go and search for your master, in case the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up and thrown him onto some mountain or into some valley. And he said, You shall not send them.

verses.kjv: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
verses.decoded: When they kept asking him until he felt embarrassed, he said, 'Send.' So they sent fifty men; they searched for three days but did not find him.

verses.kjv: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
verses.decoded: And when they came back to him, because he was staying at Jericho, he said to them, Did I not tell you, Do not go?

verses.kjv: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.
verses.decoded: The men of the city said to Elisha, Look, please, the location of this city is good, as my lord sees, but the water is bad, and the land is barren.

verses.kjv: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.
verses.decoded: He said, Bring me a new jar and put salt in it. They brought it to him.

verses.kjv: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the Lord, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
verses.decoded: He went to the spring of the waters, threw salt into it, and said, 'This is what the LORD says: I have healed these waters; there will be no more death or barren land from here.'

verses.kjv: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
verses.decoded: So the waters were healed up to this day, just as Elisha said.

verses.kjv: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
verses.decoded: He went up from there to Bethel, and as he was going up the road, some young boys came out of the city, mocked him, and said to him, 'Go up, you bald head; go up, you bald head.'

verses.kjv: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the Lord. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
verses.decoded: He turned around, looked at them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. Then two female bears came out of the forest and tore apart forty-two of the children.

verses.kjv: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
verses.decoded: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and then he returned to Samaria.

verses.kjv: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
verses.decoded: Now Jehoram, the son of Ahab, began to rule over Israel in Samaria during the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, and he ruled for twelve years.

verses.kjv: And he wrought evil in the sight of the Lord; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
verses.decoded: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, but not like his father and mother, because he removed the image of Baal that his father had made.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.decoded: However, he continued to follow the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin; he did not turn away from them.

verses.kjv: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
verses.decoded: Mesha, king of Moab, was a shepherd and gave the king of Israel one hundred thousand lambs and one hundred thousand rams, along with the wool.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
verses.decoded: After Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
verses.decoded: And King Jehoram left Samaria at that time and counted all the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.
verses.decoded: He went and sent a message to Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab? Jehoshaphat said, I will go. I am like you, my people are like your people, and my horses are like your horses.

verses.kjv: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
verses.decoded: He asked, Which way should we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

verses.kjv: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
verses.decoded: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom; and they traveled around for seven days; but there was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
verses.decoded: And the king of Israel said, "Oh no! The LORD has brought these three kings together to hand them over to Moab!"

verses.kjv: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may inquire of the Lord by him? And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
verses.decoded: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not a prophet of the LORD here, so that we can ask the LORD through him?" One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, "Here is Elisha, the son of Shaphat, who poured water on Elijah’s hands."

verses.kjv: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the Lord is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.decoded: And Jehoshaphat said, The message from the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom went down to meet him.

verses.kjv: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.decoded: And Elisha said to the king of Israel, What do I have to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father and to the prophets of your mother. But the king of Israel said to him, No, because the LORD has brought these three kings together to hand them over to Moab.

verses.kjv: And Elisha said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
verses.decoded: And Elisha said, As the LORD of armies lives, before whom I stand, truly, if I did not respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look at you or pay attention to you.

verses.kjv: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
verses.decoded: But now bring me a musician. When the musician played, the power of the LORD came upon him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of ditches.
verses.decoded: And he said, This is what the LORD says: Fill this valley with ditches.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
verses.decoded: For this is what the LORD says, You will not see wind, and you will not see rain; yet that valley will be filled with water, so that you, your cattle, and your animals can drink.

verses.kjv: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the Lord: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
verses.decoded: And this is only a small matter in the eyes of the LORD: he will also give the Moabites into your hand.

verses.kjv: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
verses.decoded: And you will attack every walled city and every important city, cut down every good tree, block all wells of water, and ruin every good piece of land with stones.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.decoded: The next morning, when the grain offering was made, water appeared along the road through Edom, and the land was filled with water.

verses.kjv: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
verses.decoded: When all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered everyone who was able to wear armor, went up, and stood at the border.

verses.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
verses.decoded: They got up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood.

verses.kjv: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
verses.decoded: And they said, This is blood: the kings are definitely dead, and they have killed each other: now, Moab, go and take the plunder.

verses.kjv: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
verses.decoded: When they reached the camp of Israel, the Israelites stood up and attacked the Moabites, causing them to run away. But the Israelites continued attacking the Moabites even in their own land.

verses.kjv: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
verses.decoded: They destroyed the cities, and on every good piece of land, each man threw a stone and filled it up; they stopped all the wells of water and cut down all the good trees. Only in Kir-haraseth did they leave the stones; however, the slingers went around it and attacked it.

verses.kjv: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
verses.decoded: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too difficult for him, he took seven hundred men with swords to try to break through to the king of Edom, but they could not.

verses.kjv: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.decoded: Then he took his oldest son, who was supposed to rule after him, and offered him as a burnt offering on the wall. This caused great anger against Israel, so they left him and returned to their own country.

verses.kjv: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the Lord: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
verses.decoded: Now a certain woman, one of the wives of the sons of the prophets, cried out to Elisha, saying, 'My husband, your servant, is dead; and you know that your servant feared the LORD. But now a creditor has come to take my two sons to be his slaves.'

verses.kjv: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.decoded: And Elisha said to her, What can I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house? And she said, Your servant does not have anything in the house, except a pot of oil.

verses.kjv: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.decoded: Then he said, Go and borrow vessels from all your neighbors, even empty vessels; do not borrow just a few.

verses.kjv: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
verses.decoded: And when you come in, you shall shut the door behind you and your sons, and you shall pour into all those vessels, and you shall set aside the ones that are full.

verses.kjv: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
verses.decoded: So she left him, closed the door behind her and her sons, who brought the containers to her; and she poured out.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.decoded: When the containers were full, she said to her son, Bring me another container. He said to her, There are no more containers. And the oil stopped flowing.

verses.kjv: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
verses.decoded: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, pay your debt, and you and your children can live on the rest.

verses.kjv: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.decoded: One day, Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; she urged him to eat bread. And it happened that whenever he passed by, he stopped there to eat bread.

verses.kjv: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
verses.decoded: And she said to her husband, Look now, I realize that this is a holy man of God who regularly passes by us.

verses.kjv: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.decoded: Let us build a small room, please, on the wall; and let us put a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp there for him: and when he comes to us, he will go in there.

verses.kjv: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
verses.decoded: One day, he came there, went into the room, and lay down there.

verses.kjv: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.decoded: He said to Gehazi his servant, 'Call this Shunammite woman.' When he called her, she stood in front of him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, Tell her, Look, you have been very concerned for us with all this care; what should be done for you? Should I speak to the king or to the commander of the army for you? And she answered, I live among my own people.

verses.kjv: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
verses.decoded: And he said, What should be done for her then? And Gehazi answered, Truly she has no child, and her husband is old.

verses.kjv: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Call her.' When he called her, she stood at the door.

verses.kjv: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
verses.decoded: And he said, Around this time next year, you will hold a son in your arms. But she said, No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.

verses.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
verses.decoded: The woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son at the time Elisha had told her, exactly when it was supposed to happen.

verses.kjv: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.decoded: When the child had grown up, one day he went out to his father who was with the harvesters.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
verses.decoded: And he said to his father, My head, my head. And he said to a boy, Take him to his mother.

verses.kjv: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.decoded: And when he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
verses.decoded: She went upstairs, placed him on the bed of the man of God, closed the door behind him, and then left.

verses.kjv: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
verses.decoded: She called her husband and said, Please send me one of the young men and one of the donkeys so I can go quickly to the man of God and come back.

verses.kjv: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
verses.decoded: And he said, Why do you want to go to him today? It is neither the new moon nor the Sabbath. And she said, It will be fine.

verses.kjv: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
verses.decoded: Then she put a saddle on a donkey and said to her servant, 'Ride on and go ahead; do not slow down your riding for me unless I tell you to.'

verses.kjv: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
verses.decoded: So she went and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her from a distance, he said to Gehazi his servant, "Look, there is the Shunammite woman."

verses.kjv: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
verses.decoded: Please run now to meet her and ask her, 'Are you well? Is your husband well? Is the child well?' And she answered, 'They are well.'

verses.kjv: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the Lord hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
verses.decoded: When she came to the man of God at the hill, she grabbed his feet, but Gehazi came close to push her away. The man of God said, Leave her alone, because her soul is troubled inside her, and the LORD has hidden it from me and has not told me.

verses.kjv: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.decoded: Then she said, Did I ask my lord for a son? Did I not say, Do not lie to me?

verses.kjv: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.decoded: Then he said to Gehazi, Prepare yourself and take my staff in your hand, and go on your way; if you meet anyone, do not greet them; and if anyone greets you, do not answer them; and place my staff on the face of the child.

verses.kjv: And the mother of the child said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.decoded: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And he got up and followed her.

verses.kjv: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.decoded: And Gehazi went ahead of them and placed the staff on the child's face; but there was no sound and no response. So he went back to meet him and told him, saying, The child has not woken up.

verses.kjv: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.decoded: When Elisha entered the house, the child was dead and lying on his bed.

verses.kjv: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: So he went inside, closed the door with the two of them inside, and prayed to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.decoded: He went up and lay on the child, placing his mouth on the child's mouth, his eyes on the child's eyes, and his hands on the child's hands. Then he stretched himself out on the child, and the child's body became warm.

verses.kjv: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.decoded: Then he came back and walked around the house; then he went upstairs and lay down on the child. The child sneezed seven times and then opened his eyes.

verses.kjv: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
verses.decoded: He called Gehazi and said, 'Call this woman from Shunem.' So Gehazi called her. When she came to him, he said, 'Pick up your son.'

verses.kjv: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
verses.decoded: Then she went inside, fell at his feet, bowed down to the ground, picked up her son, and went out.

verses.kjv: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.decoded: Elisha returned to Gilgal, and there was a famine in the land. The sons of the prophets were sitting in front of him, and he said to his servant, 'Put the large pot on the fire and cook stew for the sons of the prophets.'

verses.kjv: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verses.decoded: Someone went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered wild gourds enough to fill his lap, and came and cut them into the pot of stew, because they did not recognize them.

verses.kjv: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verses.decoded: So they served the men food to eat. While they were eating the stew, they shouted and said, 'Man of God, there is poison in the pot.' And they could not eat it.

verses.kjv: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.decoded: But he said, Then bring some flour. He threw it into the pot and said, Serve it to the people so they can eat. There was nothing harmful in the pot.

verses.kjv: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.decoded: A man came from Baal-shalisha and brought the man of God bread made from the first harvest, twenty barley loaves, and full ears of corn still in their husks. He said, "Give this to the people so they can eat."

verses.kjv: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the Lord, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
verses.decoded: And his servant said, Should I serve this to one hundred men? He said again, Give it to the people so they can eat, because the LORD says, They will eat and still have some left over.

verses.kjv: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: So he placed it in front of them, and they ate, and had some left over, just as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the Lord had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
verses.decoded: Now Naaman, the commander of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man respected by his master and honorable, because the LORD had given victory to Syria through him. He was also a brave and strong man, but he had leprosy.

verses.kjv: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.decoded: The Syrians had gone out in groups and had taken captive from the land of Israel a young girl; and she served Naaman’s wife.

verses.kjv: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
verses.decoded: And she said to her mistress, I wish my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria, because he would heal him of his leprosy.

verses.kjv: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
verses.decoded: And someone went in and told his master, saying, This is what the young woman from the land of Israel said.

verses.kjv: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.decoded: The king of Syria said, "Go ahead, go, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So he left and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten sets of clothes.

verses.kjv: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
verses.decoded: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now that this letter has come to you, I have sent Naaman my servant to you so that you may heal him of his leprosy.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
verses.decoded: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, 'Am I God, who gives life and causes death? Why does this man send someone to me to heal a man of his leprosy? Think carefully and see how he is trying to find a reason to accuse me.'

verses.kjv: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
verses.decoded: When Elisha, the man of God, heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, he sent a message to the king, saying, Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come to me now, and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel.

verses.kjv: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.decoded: So Naaman arrived with his horses and his chariot, and stood at the entrance of Elisha's house.

verses.kjv: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
verses.decoded: And Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh will be restored to you, and you will be clean.

verses.kjv: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the Lord his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.decoded: But Naaman was angry and left, saying, Look, I thought he would surely come out to me, stand there, call on the name of the LORD his God, wave his hand over the spot, and heal the leper.

verses.kjv: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.decoded: Aren't Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Can't I wash in them and be clean? So he turned and left angrily.

verses.kjv: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
verses.decoded: And his servants came close and spoke to him, saying, Father, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, wouldn’t you have done it? How much more then, when he tells you, Wash and be clean?

verses.kjv: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.decoded: Then he went down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan River, just as the man of God had said. His skin became like the skin of a young child again, and he was healed.

verses.kjv: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
verses.decoded: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his group, and came and stood before him; and he said, Look, now I know that there is no God in all the earth except in Israel. So now, please accept a gift from your servant.

verses.kjv: But he said, As the Lord liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.decoded: But he said, As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will not accept anything. And he encouraged him to accept it; but he refused.

verses.kjv: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules’ burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Naaman said, Will you not then, I ask you, give your servant two mule loads of soil? Because from now on your servant will not offer burnt offerings or sacrifices to other gods, but only to the LORD.

verses.kjv: In this thing the Lord pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the Lord pardon thy servant in this thing.
verses.decoded: In this matter, may the LORD forgive your servant, that when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow down in the house of Rimmon, when I bow down in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD forgive your servant in this matter.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
verses.decoded: And he said to him, Go in peace. So he left him and went a short distance away.

verses.kjv: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the Lord liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
verses.decoded: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Look, my master has refused to accept anything from Naaman the Syrian, but as the LORD lives, I will run after him and get something from him.

verses.kjv: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
verses.decoded: So Gehazi ran after Naaman. When Naaman saw him running after him, he got down from the chariot to meet him and said, "Is everything okay?"

verses.kjv: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
verses.decoded: And he said, Everything is fine. My master has sent me, saying, Look, right now two young men from the sons of the prophets have come to me from Mount Ephraim: please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothes.

verses.kjv: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
verses.decoded: Naaman said, 'Be satisfied, take two talents.' He insisted, and tied up two talents of silver in two bags, along with two sets of clothes, and put them on two of his servants; and they carried them in front of him.

verses.kjv: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.decoded: When he arrived at the tower, he took the items from their hands and placed them in the house; then he released the men, and they left.

verses.kjv: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
verses.decoded: But he went in and stood before his master. And Elisha said to him, Where have you come from, Gehazi? And he said, Your servant did not go anywhere.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
verses.decoded: And he said to him, Did my heart not go with you when the man turned back from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to accept money and to accept clothes, olive groves, vineyards, sheep, oxen, male servants, and female servants?

verses.kjv: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
verses.decoded: So the leprosy of Naaman will stick to you and to your descendants forever. And he left his presence as a leper, as white as snow.

verses.kjv: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
verses.decoded: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, Look, the place where we live with you is too small for us.

verses.kjv: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.
verses.decoded: Let us go to the Jordan River and each of us take a log from there, and let us build a place to live. He replied, Go ahead.

verses.kjv: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
verses.decoded: And one said, Please be satisfied and go with your servants. And he answered, I will go.

verses.kjv: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
verses.decoded: So he went with them. When they arrived at the Jordan River, they cut down wood.

verses.kjv: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
verses.decoded: But while someone was cutting down a beam, the axe head fell into the water; and he shouted, and said, "Oh no, sir! It was borrowed."

verses.kjv: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.
verses.decoded: The man of God asked, 'Where did it fall?' The man showed him the place. Then he cut down a stick and threw it into the water there, and the iron floated.

verses.kjv: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
verses.decoded: So he said, 'Pick it up for yourself.' And he reached out his hand and took it.

verses.kjv: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Syria made war against Israel and consulted with his servants, saying, I will set up my camp at this place.

verses.kjv: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
verses.decoded: The man of God sent a message to the king of Israel, saying, Be careful not to go through that place, because the Syrians have come down there.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
verses.decoded: The king of Israel sent people to the place the man of God had told him about and warned him of, and he saved himself there more than once.

verses.kjv: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?
verses.decoded: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was very troubled about this; and he called his servants and said to them, Will you not show me which of us is loyal to the king of Israel?

verses.kjv: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
verses.decoded: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.

verses.kjv: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
verses.decoded: And he said, Go and find out where he is, so that I can send and bring him. And it was reported to him, saying, Look, he is in Dothan.

verses.kjv: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
verses.decoded: So he sent horses, chariots, and a large army there; and they came at night and surrounded the city.

verses.kjv: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
verses.decoded: When the servant of the man of God got up early and went outside, he saw an army surrounding the city with horses and chariots. Then his servant said to him, "Oh no, my master! What are we going to do?"

verses.kjv: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
verses.decoded: And he answered, Do not be afraid, because those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

verses.kjv: And Elisha prayed, and said, Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
verses.decoded: And Elisha prayed and said, Lord, please open his eyes so he can see. Then the Lord opened the young man's eyes, and he saw that the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

verses.kjv: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the Lord, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
verses.decoded: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD and said, 'Please strike these people with blindness.' And the LORD struck them with blindness as Elisha had said.

verses.kjv: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.
verses.decoded: And Elisha said to them, This is not the way, and this is not the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man you are looking for. So he led them to Samaria.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, Lord, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the Lord opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
verses.decoded: When they arrived in Samaria, Elisha said, 'Lord, open the eyes of these men so they can see.' The Lord opened their eyes, and they saw that they were in the middle of Samaria.

verses.kjv: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
verses.decoded: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, 'My father, should I attack them? Should I attack them?'

verses.kjv: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
verses.decoded: And he answered, You must not kill them: would you kill those whom you have captured with your sword and your bow? Put bread and water in front of them so that they can eat and drink and then return to their master.

verses.kjv: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
verses.decoded: He prepared a large amount of food and supplies for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away, and they returned to their leader. From that time on, the groups from Syria did not enter the land of Israel anymore.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
verses.decoded: After this, Ben-hadad, king of Syria, gathered all his army, went up, and surrounded Samaria to attack it.

verses.kjv: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass’s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.
verses.decoded: There was a severe famine in Samaria, and they surrounded the city. An donkey's head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and a quarter of a measure of dove's dung was sold for five pieces of silver.

verses.kjv: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
verses.decoded: As the king of Israel was walking along the wall, a woman called out to him, saying, Help me, my lord, O king.

verses.kjv: And he said, If the Lord do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
verses.decoded: And he said, If the LORD does not help you, where will I get help for you? From the threshing floor or from the winepress?

verses.kjv: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
verses.decoded: And the king said to her, What is wrong with you? And she answered, This woman said to me, Give your son, so that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.

verses.kjv: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.
verses.decoded: So we boiled my son and ate him; and the next day I said to her, 'Give me your son so we can eat him,' but she has hidden her son.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
verses.decoded: When the king heard the woman's words, he tore his clothes. Then he walked along the wall, and the people saw that he was wearing sackcloth next to his skin.

verses.kjv: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
verses.decoded: Then he said, May God do so and even more to me if Elisha son of Shaphat's head remains on him today.

verses.kjv: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?
verses.decoded: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him; and the king sent a man ahead of him: but before the messenger arrived, he said to the elders, Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold him tightly at the door: isn’t the sound of his master’s footsteps behind him?

verses.kjv: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the Lord; what should I wait for the Lord any longer?
verses.decoded: While he was still talking with them, the messenger came down to him and said, "This disaster is from the LORD; why should I keep waiting for the LORD any longer?"

verses.kjv: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
verses.decoded: Then Elisha said, Listen to the word of the LORD; This is what the LORD says: Tomorrow around this time, a measure of fine flour will be sold for one shekel, and two measures of barley will be sold for one shekel, at the gate of Samaria.

verses.kjv: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the Lord would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
verses.decoded: Then a royal official whom the king trusted answered the man of God and said, Look, if the LORD would open windows in heaven, could this happen? And he said, Look, you will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it.

verses.kjv: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
verses.decoded: There were four men with leprosy sitting at the entrance of the city gate, and they said to each other, Why are we sitting here until we die?

verses.kjv: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
verses.decoded: If we say, We will go into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we will die there; and if we stay here quietly, we will also die. So now come, let us attack the Syrian army; if they keep us alive, we will live, and if they kill us, we will just die.

verses.kjv: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.
verses.decoded: They got up at dusk to go to the camp of the Syrians, and when they reached the far edge of the Syrian camp, they saw that there was no one there.

verses.kjv: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
verses.decoded: Because the Lord caused the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the sound of a large army, and they said to each other, Look, the king of Israel has hired the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.

verses.kjv: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
verses.decoded: Therefore they got up and ran away at dusk, leaving their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, the entire camp just as it was, and ran for their lives.

verses.kjv: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.
verses.decoded: When these lepers reached the farthest part of the camp, they entered one tent, ate and drank, took silver, gold, and clothing from there, went and hid it; then they returned, entered another tent, took more, and went and hid it.

verses.kjv: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.
verses.decoded: Then they said to each other, We are not doing right: today is a day of good news, and we are keeping quiet: if we wait until morning, some trouble will happen to us: so now come, let us go and tell the king’s household.

verses.kjv: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
verses.decoded: So they went and called to the gatekeeper of the city, and they told him, saying, We went to the camp of the Syrians, and look, there was no one there, no sound of people, but the horses were tied up, and the donkeys were tied up, and the tents were just as they were.

verses.kjv: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king’s house within.
verses.decoded: He called the gatekeepers, and they reported it to those inside the king’s palace.

verses.kjv: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
verses.decoded: And the king got up during the night and said to his servants, I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry; so they have left the camp to hide themselves in the fields, saying, When they come out of the city, we will capture them alive and enter the city.

verses.kjv: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.
verses.decoded: And one of his servants answered and said, Please let some take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (look, they are like all the people of Israel who are left there: look, I say, they are like all the people of Israel who have been destroyed:) and let us send and see.

verses.kjv: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
verses.decoded: So they took two chariot horses, and the king sent them after the army of the Syrians, saying, Go and find out what is happening.

verses.kjv: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
verses.decoded: They went after them to the Jordan River, and look, the whole road was full of clothes and containers that the Syrians had thrown away in their hurry. Then the messengers returned and told the king.

verses.kjv: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The people went out and took everything from the tents of the Syrians. A measure of fine flour was sold for one shekel, and two measures of barley were sold for one shekel, just as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.
verses.decoded: The king assigned the official he trusted to be in charge of the gate, but the people trampled him at the gate, and he died, just as the man of God had said when the king visited him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:
verses.decoded: It happened just as the man of God had told the king, saying, Two measures of barley for one shekel, and one measure of fine flour for one shekel, will be available tomorrow around this time at the gate of Samaria.

verses.kjv: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the Lord should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
verses.decoded: Then the official answered the man of God and said, Now, look, if the LORD opened windows in heaven, could such a thing happen? And he said, Look, you will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it.

verses.kjv: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
verses.decoded: And this happened to him: because the people trampled him at the gate, and he died.

verses.kjv: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the Lord hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
verses.decoded: Then Elisha spoke to the woman whose son he had brought back to life, saying, Get up and go with your household and live wherever you can live, because the LORD has announced a famine, and it will come on the land for seven years.

verses.kjv: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
verses.decoded: The woman got up and did what the man of God told her to do: she went with her family and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the seven years’ end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
verses.decoded: At the end of seven years, the woman came back from the land of the Philistines and went to appeal to the king for her house and her land.

verses.kjv: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.
verses.decoded: The king spoke with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, saying, Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
verses.decoded: It happened while he was telling the king how he had brought a dead person back to life, that the woman whose son he had brought back to life came to the king to ask for her house and her land. Gehazi said, "My lord, O king, this is the woman and this is her son whom Elisha brought back to life."

verses.kjv: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
verses.decoded: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king assigned an officer to her, saying, Return everything that belonged to her, including all the crops from the fields since the day she left the land until now.

verses.kjv: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
verses.decoded: Elisha went to Damascus, and Ben-hadad, the king of Syria, was sick. Someone told him, saying, 'The man of God has come here.'

verses.kjv: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and inquire of the Lord by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
verses.decoded: And the king said to Hazael, Take a gift in your hand, and go, meet the man of God, and ask the LORD through him, saying, Will I recover from this disease?

verses.kjv: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
verses.decoded: So Hazael went to meet him and brought a gift with him, consisting of every good thing from Damascus, enough to load forty camels. He came and stood before him and said, 'Your son Ben-hadad, king of Syria, has sent me to you, asking, "Will I recover from this illness?"'

verses.kjv: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the Lord hath shewed me that he shall surely die.
verses.decoded: And Elisha said to him, Go, tell him, You may definitely recover; however, the LORD has shown me that he will certainly die.

verses.kjv: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.
verses.decoded: He looked at him steadily until he felt ashamed, and the man of God cried.

verses.kjv: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
verses.decoded: And Hazael said, Why is my lord crying? And he answered, Because I know the harm you will do to the people of Israel: you will set their strongholds on fire, kill their young men with the sword, smash their children, and tear open their pregnant women.

verses.kjv: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The Lord hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.
verses.decoded: And Hazael said, But what, is your servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria.

verses.kjv: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.
verses.decoded: So he left Elisha and went to his master, who asked him, "What did Elisha say to you?" He answered, "He told me that you will definitely recover."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: The next day, he took a thick cloth, soaked it in water, and placed it on his face, and he died; and Hazael became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
verses.decoded: In the fifth year of Joram, the son of Ahab, king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was king of Judah, Jehoram, the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.decoded: He followed the ways of the kings of Israel, just like the family of Ahab did, because the daughter of Ahab was his wife; and he did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.
verses.decoded: But the LORD did not destroy Judah because of David his servant, as he had promised to always give him a descendant to rule, and to his children.

verses.kjv: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
verses.decoded: During his reign, Edom rebelled against Judah's control and appointed their own king.

verses.kjv: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
verses.decoded: So Joram crossed over to Zair, with all the chariots following him. He got up during the night and attacked the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the commanders of the chariots. The people ran back into their tents.

verses.kjv: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
verses.decoded: But Edom rebelled against Judah's control up to this day. At the same time, Libnah also rebelled.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other events of Joram's reign and everything he did—aren't they recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: And Joram died and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David, and his son Ahaziah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
verses.decoded: In the twelfth year of Joram, the son of Ahab, king of Israel, Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
verses.decoded: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord, as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.
verses.decoded: He followed the practices of the family of Ahab and did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like the family of Ahab did, because he was the son-in-law of the family of Ahab.

verses.kjv: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
verses.decoded: He went with Joram, the son of Ahab, to fight against Hazael, king of Syria, at Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians injured Joram.
