verses.kjv: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.decoded: King Joram returned to Jezreel to be healed from the wounds that the Syrians had given him at Ramah when he fought against Hazael, king of Syria. And Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram, the son of Ahab, in Jezreel because he was sick.

verses.kjv: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:
verses.decoded: And Elisha the prophet called one of the young prophets and said to him, Prepare yourself and take this container of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

verses.kjv: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
verses.decoded: And when you get there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, go in, make him stand up from among his companions, and take him into a private room;

verses.kjv: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
verses.decoded: Then take the container of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, This is what the LORD says: I have chosen you to be king over Israel. Then open the door, and run away, and do not delay.

verses.kjv: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.decoded: So the young man, the young man who was the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.kjv: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
verses.decoded: When he arrived, the army commanders were sitting together; he said, "I have a message for you, captain." Jehu asked, "Which one of us?" He replied, "To you, captain."

verses.kjv: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.
verses.decoded: He got up and went into the house; he poured oil on his head and said to him, 'This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I have chosen you to be king over the people of the LORD, over Israel.'

verses.kjv: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezebel.
verses.decoded: And you shall strike the house of Ahab your master, so that I may take revenge for the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, by the hand of Jezebel.

verses.kjv: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
verses.decoded: Because the entire family of Ahab will be destroyed, I will eliminate from Ahab everyone who urinates against the wall and everyone who is confined and remaining in Israel.

verses.kjv: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
verses.decoded: And I will destroy the family of Ahab just like I destroyed the family of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and the family of Baasha son of Ahijah.

verses.kjv: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.
verses.decoded: And the dogs will eat Jezebel in the area of Jezreel, and no one will bury her. Then he opened the door and ran away.

verses.kjv: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
verses.decoded: Then Jehu came out to the servants of his master, and one said to him, Is everything all right? Why did this crazy man come to you? And he said to them, You know the man and how he talks.

verses.kjv: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel.
verses.decoded: And they said, It is not true; tell us now. And he said, This is what he told me, saying, This is what the LORD says, I have anointed you king over Israel.

verses.kjv: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
verses.decoded: Then they hurried, and each man took his garment and spread it out on the top of the stairs, and blew trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

verses.kjv: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
verses.decoded: So Jehu, the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi, planned against Joram. (At that time, Joram and all Israel were holding Ramoth-gilead because of Hazael, king of Syria.

verses.kjv: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.
verses.decoded: But King Joram returned to Jezreel to be healed from the wounds that the Syrians had given him when he fought against Hazael, king of Syria. And Jehu said, If this is your intention, then let no one leave or escape from the city to go and report it in Jezreel.

verses.kjv: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
verses.decoded: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel because Joram was there. And Ahaziah, king of Judah, had come down to visit Joram.

verses.kjv: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
verses.decoded: A watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he saw Jehu's group coming and said, "I see a group of people." Then Joram said, "Take a horseman and send him to meet them, and let him ask, 'Is there peace?'"

verses.kjv: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
verses.decoded: Then someone rode on a horse to meet him and said, "This is what the king says: Is there peace?" But Jehu replied, "What do you have to do with peace? Go behind me." The watchman reported, saying, "The messenger came to them, but he is not coming back."

verses.kjv: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
verses.decoded: Then he sent out a second rider on horseback, who came to them and said, "This is what the king says: Is there peace?" And Jehu answered, "What do you have to do with peace? Go behind me."

verses.kjv: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
verses.decoded: The watchman reported, saying, He came right up to them and does not come back: and the way he drives is like the way Jehu son of Nimshi drives; because he drives wildly.

verses.kjv: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.decoded: And Joram said, Get ready. And his chariot was prepared. And Joram, king of Israel, and Ahaziah, king of Judah, went out, each in his own chariot, and they went out to meet Jehu, and they met him in the field that belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
verses.decoded: When Joram saw Jehu, he asked, "Is there peace, Jehu?" Jehu replied, "What peace can there be as long as the immoral acts of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft are so many?"

verses.kjv: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
verses.decoded: And Joram turned around, fled, and said to Ahaziah, "There is betrayal, Ahaziah."

verses.kjv: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
verses.decoded: And Jehu pulled the bow with all his strength and shot Jehoram between the arms, the arrow went through his heart, and he fell down in his chariot.

verses.kjv: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the Lord laid this burden upon him;
verses.decoded: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, Pick him up and throw him into the part of Naboth the Jezreelite's field, because remember when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD put this punishment on him;

verses.kjv: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the Lord; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the Lord. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: I certainly saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons yesterday, says the LORD; and I will repay you in this plot of land, says the LORD. Now then, take him and throw him into the plot of land, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
verses.decoded: But when Ahaziah, the king of Judah, saw this, he ran away through the path of the garden house. Jehu chased after him and said, "Strike him also while he is in the chariot." They did so at the ascent to Gur, which is near Ibleam. Then he fled to Megiddo and died there.

verses.kjv: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.decoded: His servants took him in a chariot to Jerusalem and buried him in his tomb with his ancestors in the city of David.

verses.kjv: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
verses.decoded: In the eleventh year of Joram, the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

verses.kjv: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
verses.decoded: When Jehu arrived at Jezreel, Jezebel heard about it; she put on makeup, fixed her hair, and looked out of a window.

verses.kjv: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
verses.decoded: When Jehu entered the gate, she asked, 'Did Zimri have peace after he killed his master?'

verses.kjv: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
verses.decoded: He looked up toward the window and said, "Who is on my side? Who?" Then two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
verses.decoded: He said, "Throw her down." So they threw her down, and some of her blood splattered on the wall and on the horses. He trampled her underfoot.

verses.kjv: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.
verses.decoded: When he came in, he ate and drank, and said, Go, look at this cursed woman, and bury her, because she is a king’s daughter.

verses.kjv: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
verses.decoded: They went to bury her, but they only found her skull, her feet, and the palms of her hands.

verses.kjv: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
verses.decoded: So they came back and told him. And he said, This is the message from the LORD, which he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the area of Jezreel, dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel:

verses.kjv: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
verses.decoded: And the dead body of Jezebel will be like manure on the surface of the field in the area of Jezreel; so that no one will say, This is Jezebel.

verses.kjv: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children, saying,
verses.decoded: Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the leaders of Jezreel, to the elders, and to those who raised Ahab’s children, saying,

verses.kjv: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
verses.decoded: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, also a fortified city and weapons;

verses.kjv: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.
verses.decoded: Choose the best and most suitable of your master’s sons, place him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s family.

verses.kjv: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
verses.decoded: But they were very afraid and said, Look, two kings have not stood before him; how then can we stand?

verses.kjv: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.
verses.decoded: The man in charge of the palace, the man in charge of the city, the elders, and the caretakers of the children sent a message to Jehu, saying, 'We are your servants and will do everything you command us; we will not appoint any king. Do what you think is best.'

verses.kjv: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
verses.decoded: Then he wrote a second letter to them, saying, If you belong to me, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow. Now the king’s sons, seventy in number, were with the important men of the city who raised them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.
verses.decoded: When the letter arrived to them, they took the king’s sons, killed seventy people, put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him in Jezreel.

verses.kjv: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
verses.decoded: A messenger came and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Put them in two piles at the entrance of the gate until morning.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
verses.decoded: The next morning, he went outside, stood before all the people, and said, You are all innocent; look, I planned against my master and killed him, but who killed all these others?

verses.kjv: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the Lord, which the Lord spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the Lord hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
verses.decoded: Understand now that none of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spoke about the house of Ahab, will fail to happen; because the LORD has done exactly what he said through his servant Elijah.

verses.kjv: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
verses.decoded: So Jehu killed everyone left from the family of Ahab in Jezreel, including all his important officials, relatives, and priests, until he left no one alive.

verses.kjv: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
verses.decoded: He got up and left, and went to Samaria. While he was at the shearing house along the road,

verses.kjv: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
verses.decoded: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah, king of Judah, and said, Who are you? They answered, We are the brothers of Ahaziah; and we are going down to greet the sons of the king and the sons of the queen.

verses.kjv: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
verses.decoded: And he said, Capture them alive. So they captured them alive and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, forty-two men in all; he did not leave any of them alive.

verses.kjv: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
verses.decoded: After he left there, he met Jehonadab, the son of Rechab, coming to meet him. He greeted him and said, "Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?" Jehonadab answered, "It is." Then he said, "If it is, give me your hand." He gave him his hand, and he brought him up into the chariot.

verses.kjv: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the Lord. So they made him ride in his chariot.
verses.decoded: He said, Come with me and see how passionate I am about the LORD. So they let him ride in his chariot.

verses.kjv: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the Lord, which he spake to Elijah.
verses.decoded: When he arrived at Samaria, he killed everyone left from Ahab's family in Samaria until he completely destroyed them, just as the LORD had said to Elijah.

verses.kjv: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.
verses.decoded: And Jehu gathered all the people together and said to them, Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much more.

verses.kjv: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
verses.decoded: Now, call to me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be missing, because I have a great sacrifice to offer to Baal. Whoever is missing will not live. But Jehu did this secretly, intending to destroy the worshippers of Baal.

verses.kjv: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
verses.decoded: And Jehu said, Announce a special gathering for Baal. And they announced it.

verses.kjv: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
verses.decoded: And Jehu sent messages throughout all Israel, and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was no one who did not come. They entered the house of Baal, and the house of Baal was full from one end to the other.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
verses.decoded: And he said to the person in charge of the wardrobe, Bring out clothes for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought out the clothes.

verses.kjv: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the Lord, but the worshippers of Baal only.
verses.decoded: Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said to the worshippers of Baal, Search and make sure that there are no servants of the LORD here with you, but only worshippers of Baal.

verses.kjv: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
verses.decoded: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu stationed eighty men outside and said, If any of the men I have handed over to you escape, the person who lets him go will have to give his own life in exchange.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
verses.decoded: After he finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and the captains, 'Go in and kill them; do not let anyone escape.' They killed them with the sword, and the guard and the captains threw their bodies out and then went to the city of the house of Baal.

verses.kjv: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
verses.decoded: They took the idols out of the house of Baal and burned them.

verses.kjv: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
verses.decoded: And they destroyed the statue of Baal, and destroyed the temple of Baal, and turned it into a place for drying clothes to this day.

verses.kjv: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
verses.decoded: In this way, Jehu completely eliminated Baal worship from Israel.

verses.kjv: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.
verses.decoded: However, Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin, specifically the golden calves that were in Bethel and in Dan.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Jehu, Because you have done well in carrying out what is right in my eyes, and have done to the house of Ahab everything that was in my heart, your children to the fourth generation will sit on the throne of Israel.

verses.kjv: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: But Jehu did not pay attention to following the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart, because he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: In those days the Lord began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
verses.decoded: At that time, the LORD began to reduce Israel's power, and Hazael attacked them in all the regions of Israel.

verses.kjv: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
verses.decoded: From the Jordan River eastward, all the land of Gilead, the people of Gad, the people of Reuben, and the people of Manasseh, from Aroer, which is beside the Arnon River, including Gilead and Bashan.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The rest of the actions of Jehu, everything he did, and all his power, are they not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jehu died and was buried with his ancestors in Samaria. Then his son Jehoahaz became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.
verses.decoded: Jehu ruled over Israel in Samaria for twenty-eight years.

verses.kjv: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
verses.decoded: When Athaliah, the mother of Ahaziah, saw that her son was dead, she got up and killed all the members of the royal family.

verses.kjv: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
verses.decoded: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash, the son of Ahaziah, and rescued him from among the king’s sons who had been killed; and they hid him, along with his nurse, in the bedroom away from Athaliah, so that he was not killed.

verses.kjv: And he was with her hid in the house of the Lord six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
verses.decoded: And he was hidden with her in the house of the LORD for six years. And Athaliah ruled over the land.

verses.kjv: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the Lord, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the Lord, and shewed them the king’s son.
verses.decoded: In the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, along with the captains and the guards, and brought them to him inside the house of the LORD. He made a covenant with them, made them swear an oath in the house of the LORD, and showed them the king’s son.

verses.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;
verses.decoded: And he gave them orders, saying, This is what you will do: One third of you who enter on the Sabbath will be guards of the king’s palace;

verses.kjv: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
verses.decoded: And one third will be at the Sur gate; and one third will be at the gate behind the guard: this is how you will keep watch over the house, so that it will not be broken into.

verses.kjv: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the Lord about the king.
verses.decoded: And two groups of all of you who go out on the Sabbath, they will keep watch over the house of the LORD around the king.

verses.kjv: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.
verses.decoded: And you will surround the king all around, each man with his weapons in his hand; and anyone who comes within the ranks, let him be killed; and be with the king as he goes out and as he comes in.

verses.kjv: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
verses.decoded: The captains of the hundreds did everything that Jehoiada the priest commanded: each captain gathered his men who were supposed to come in on the Sabbath, along with those who were supposed to go out on the Sabbath, and they came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.kjv: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And the priest gave the commanders of hundreds King David’s spears and shields, which were in the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.
verses.decoded: And the guard stood, each man holding his weapons in his hand, all around the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along the altar and the temple.

verses.kjv: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.
verses.decoded: He brought out the king’s son, placed the crown on his head, gave him the official documents, made him king, and anointed him; then they clapped their hands and said, 'God save the king.'

verses.kjv: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the Lord.
verses.decoded: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guard and the people, she went to the people in the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
verses.decoded: And when she looked, she saw the king standing by a pillar, as was the custom, with the princes and the trumpeters beside the king, and all the people of the land were happy and blew their trumpets; and Athaliah tore her clothes and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"

verses.kjv: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the army, and said to them, 'Bring her out beyond the ranks; and anyone who follows her, kill with the sword.' For the priest had said, 'Do not kill her inside the house of the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.
verses.decoded: They seized her; and she went along the path where the horses entered the king’s house, and there she was killed.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord and the king and the people, that they should be the Lord’s people; between the king also and the people.
verses.decoded: And Jehoiada made an agreement between the LORD, the king, and the people that they would be the LORD’S people; and also between the king and the people.

verses.kjv: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: All the people of the land went into the house of Baal and tore it down; they completely destroyed his altars and his images, and they killed Mattan, the priest of Baal, in front of the altars. Then the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the Lord, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
verses.decoded: He took the leaders of hundreds, the captains, the guards, and all the people of the land; and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD, and went through the gate of the guard to the king’s house. Then he sat on the throne of the kings.

verses.kjv: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.
verses.decoded: All the people in the land were happy, and the city was peaceful; they killed Athaliah with the sword next to the king’s house.

verses.kjv: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
verses.decoded: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

verses.kjv: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
verses.decoded: In the seventh year of Jehu's reign, Jehoash began to rule; he ruled in Jerusalem for forty years. His mother's name was Zibiah from Beer-sheba.

verses.kjv: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
verses.decoded: Jehoash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD throughout all the days that Jehoiada the priest taught him.

verses.kjv: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
verses.decoded: But the high places were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense at the high places.

verses.kjv: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the Lord, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
verses.decoded: Jehoash said to the priests, All the money from the dedicated offerings brought into the house of the LORD, including the money from everyone who passes by the account, the amount assigned to each person, and all the money that anyone feels willing to bring into the house of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
verses.decoded: Let the priests receive it from each person they know, and let them repair the damages to the house wherever any damage is found.

verses.kjv: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
verses.decoded: But it happened that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests had not fixed the damages in the temple.

verses.kjv: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
verses.decoded: Then King Jehoash called Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and said to them, Why are you not repairing the damages to the temple? From now on, do not accept any more money from your friends, but use it to repair the damages to the temple.

verses.kjv: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
verses.decoded: The priests agreed to stop accepting money from the people and also to stop repairing the damages to the temple.

verses.kjv: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the Lord: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, made a hole in its lid, and placed it beside the altar on the right side as you enter the house of the LORD; and the priests who guarded the door put all the money brought into the house of the LORD into it.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: When they saw that there was a lot of money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came and put the money into bags, and they counted the money that was found in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the Lord: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the Lord,
verses.decoded: And they gave the money, as instructed, into the hands of those who did the work and supervised the house of the LORD; and they paid the carpenters and builders who worked on the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the Lord, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
verses.decoded: And to the masons and stone cutters, and to buy wood and cut stone to repair the broken parts of the house of the LORD, and for everything that was spent to repair the house.

verses.kjv: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the Lord bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the Lord:
verses.decoded: However, bowls of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver were not made for the house of the LORD from the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But they gave that money to the workers, and they used it to repair the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
verses.decoded: Also, they did not give an account to the men who received the money to pay the workers, because they acted honestly.

verses.kjv: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the Lord: it was the priests’.
verses.decoded: The money for trespasses and sins was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests.

verses.kjv: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Then Hazael, king of Syria, went up and fought against Gath and captured it; and Hazael determined to go up to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Jehoash, king of Judah, took all the sacred items that Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his ancestors who were kings of Judah, had dedicated, along with his own sacred items, and all the gold found in the treasures of the Lord's house and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael, king of Syria. Then Hazael left Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other events of Joash's reign and everything he did are not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
verses.decoded: And his servants got up, planned a conspiracy, and killed Joash in the house of Millo, which goes down to Silla.

verses.kjv: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Because Jozachar, the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad, the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him down and he died; they buried him with his ancestors in the city of David, and Amaziah his son became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
verses.decoded: In the twenty-third year of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, began to reign over Israel in Samaria and reigned for seventeen years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD and followed the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin; he did not turn away from them.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
verses.decoded: The LORD became angry with Israel and allowed them to be captured by Hazael, king of Syria, and by Ben-hadad, the son of Hazael, throughout their entire history.

verses.kjv: And Jehoahaz besought the Lord, and the Lord hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
verses.decoded: And Jehoahaz prayed to the LORD, and the LORD listened to him because He saw the suffering of Israel, since the king of Syria was oppressing them.

verses.kjv: (And the Lord gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
verses.decoded: The LORD gave Israel a savior, so they were able to escape from the control of the Syrians, and the people of Israel lived in their homes as they had before.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
verses.decoded: However, they did not stop doing the sins of the family of Jeroboam, who caused Israel to sin, but continued in them; and the sacred pole also remained in Samaria.

verses.kjv: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
verses.decoded: He did not leave to Jehoahaz more than fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers, because the king of Syria had destroyed the rest and crushed them like dust by threshing.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other events of Jehoahaz's reign, everything he did, and his power, are not they recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jehoahaz died and was buried with his ancestors in Samaria. His son Joash became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
verses.decoded: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash, king of Judah, Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz, began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned for sixteen years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD; he did not turn away from all the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin, but he continued to follow them.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other actions of Joash, everything he did, and the strength he showed when he fought against Amaziah, king of Judah, are they not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: Joash died and was buried with his ancestors; Jeroboam became king in his place. Joash was buried in Samaria alongside the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
verses.decoded: Now Elisha became seriously ill with the sickness that would cause his death. King Joash of Israel came to him, wept over him, and said, "My father, my father, the chariot of Israel and its horsemen."

verses.kjv: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
verses.decoded: And Elisha said to him, Take the bow and arrows. And he took the bow and arrows.

verses.kjv: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.
verses.decoded: And he said to the king of Israel, Put your hand on the bow. And he put his hand on it, and Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands.

verses.kjv: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the Lord’s deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
verses.decoded: He said, Open the window facing east. He opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. He shot. Elisha said, This is the arrow of the LORD’s deliverance, the arrow of deliverance from Syria; because you will strike the Syrians at Aphek until you have completely destroyed them.

verses.kjv: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
verses.decoded: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said to the king of Israel, Strike the ground. And he struck three times, then stopped.

verses.kjv: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.
verses.decoded: And the man of God was angry with him and said, You should have struck five or six times; then you would have defeated Syria completely. But now you will only strike Syria three times.

verses.kjv: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
verses.decoded: Elisha died, and they buried him. At the beginning of the year, groups of Moabite raiders invaded the land.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verses.decoded: It happened while they were burying a man that they saw a group of men coming; so they threw the man into Elisha's tomb. When the man was lowered and touched Elisha's bones, he came back to life and stood up on his feet.

verses.kjv: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
verses.decoded: But Hazael, king of Syria, oppressed Israel throughout the entire reign of Jehoahaz.

verses.kjv: And the Lord was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
verses.decoded: The LORD was kind to them, felt sorry for them, and cared about them because of his agreement with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and he did not destroy them or remove them from his presence yet.

verses.kjv: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Hazael, the king of Syria, died; and his son Ben-hadad became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
verses.decoded: Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz, took back from Ben-hadad, the son of Hazael, the cities that Ben-hadad had taken from Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash defeated him three times and recovered the cities of Israel.

verses.kjv: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
verses.decoded: In the second year of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah, son of Joash, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not like his father David; he did everything the way his father Joash did.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
verses.decoded: However, the high places were not removed; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
verses.decoded: And it happened, as soon as the kingdom was firmly in his control, that he killed the servants who had killed his father, the king.

verses.kjv: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
verses.decoded: But he did not kill the children of the murderers, following what is written in the book of the law of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, 'Fathers will not be put to death because of their children, nor will children be put to death because of their fathers; each person will be put to death for their own sin.'

verses.kjv: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
verses.decoded: He killed ten thousand men of Edom in the Valley of Salt, captured Selah by force, and named it Joktheel, which is still its name today.

verses.kjv: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
verses.decoded: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us meet face to face.

verses.kjv: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.decoded: Jehoash, the king of Israel, sent a message to Amaziah, the king of Judah, saying, The thistle in Lebanon sent a message to the cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son as his wife; but a wild animal from Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.

verses.kjv: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.decoded: You have indeed defeated Edom, and your heart has become proud: celebrate this and stay at home, because why should you interfere and bring harm upon yourself, causing both you and Judah to fall?

verses.kjv: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
verses.decoded: But Amaziah did not listen. So Jehoash, king of Israel, went up; and he and Amaziah, king of Judah, faced each other at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

verses.kjv: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.
verses.decoded: Judah was defeated by Israel, and each person fled back to their own tents.

verses.kjv: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.decoded: And Jehoash, king of Israel, captured Amaziah, king of Judah, who was the son of Jehoash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and went to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate, a length of four hundred cubits.

verses.kjv: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
verses.decoded: He took all the gold and silver, and all the items found in the house of the LORD, and in the king’s treasury, along with hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other things that Jehoash did, his strength, and how he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and his son Jeroboam became king after him.

verses.kjv: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
verses.decoded: Amaziah, the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: Are not the other events of Amaziah's reign recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
verses.decoded: They planned a secret plot against him in Jerusalem, so he ran away to Lachish; but they sent people after him to Lachish and killed him there.

verses.kjv: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
verses.decoded: They carried him on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors in the city of David.

verses.kjv: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
verses.decoded: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

verses.kjv: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.decoded: He rebuilt Elath and returned it to Judah after the king died.

verses.kjv: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
verses.decoded: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah, the son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam, the son of Joash, king of Israel, began to reign in Samaria and reigned for forty-one years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD; he did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.
verses.decoded: He rebuilt the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the Mediterranean Sea, just as the LORD God of Israel said through his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath-hepher.

verses.kjv: For the Lord saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
verses.decoded: Because the LORD saw the suffering of Israel, which was very severe, since there was no one imprisoned, no one remaining, and no helper for Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
verses.decoded: And the LORD did not say that he would erase the name of Israel from the earth, but he saved them through Jeroboam, the son of Joash.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: Now the other actions of Jeroboam, everything he did, his strength, how he fought, and how he took back Damascus and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are these not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.kjv: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jeroboam died and was buried with his ancestors, the kings of Israel; and his son Zachariah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.decoded: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam, king of Israel, Azariah, son of Amaziah, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecholiah from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

verses.kjv: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
verses.decoded: Except that the high places were not taken away: the people continued to sacrifice and burn incense on the high places.

verses.kjv: And the Lord smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
verses.decoded: And the LORD struck the king with leprosy, so that he had leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. And Jotham, the king’s son, was in charge of the palace, governing the people of the land.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: Are the rest of the actions of Azariah, and everything he did, not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: So Azariah died; and they buried him with his ancestors in the city of David. Then his son Jotham became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
verses.decoded: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah, king of Judah, Zachariah, the son of Jeroboam, ruled over Israel in Samaria for six months.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like his ancestors did; he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: And Shallum, the son of Jabesh, plotted against him, struck him down in front of the people, killed him, and became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: The other events of Zachariah's reign are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: This was the word of the Lord which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
verses.decoded: This was the message from the LORD that he spoke to Jehu, saying, Your sons will sit on the throne of Israel until the fourth generation. And it happened just as he said.

verses.kjv: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
verses.decoded: Shallum, the son of Jabesh, began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah, king of Judah; and he reigned for one full month in Samaria.

verses.kjv: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Menahem, the son of Gadi, went up from Tirzah to Samaria, attacked Shallum, the son of Jabesh, in Samaria, killed him, and became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: The other actions of Shallum and the plot he made are written in the book of the records of the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
verses.decoded: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and everyone inside it, including the surrounding areas from Tirzah. Because they did not open the city to him, he attacked it; and he tore open all the pregnant women inside.

verses.kjv: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
verses.decoded: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah, king of Judah, Menahem, the son of Gadi, began to reign over Israel, and he reigned ten years in Samaria.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: And he did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD: he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat during all his life, the one who caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
verses.decoded: And Pul, the king of Assyria, came against the land; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver so that he would support him and confirm his kingdom.

verses.kjv: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
verses.decoded: Menahem collected money from Israel, even from all the wealthy and powerful men, fifty shekels of silver from each man, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back and did not stay in the land.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.decoded: The other actions of Menahem and everything he did are recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel, aren't they?

verses.kjv: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
verses.decoded: In the fiftieth year of Azariah, king of Judah, Pekahiah, the son of Menahem, began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned for two years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD; he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
verses.decoded: But Pekah, the son of Remaliah, one of his captains, plotted against him and struck him down in Samaria, inside the king’s palace, along with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men from Gilead. He killed him and became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: The other actions of Pekahiah and everything he did are written in the book of the records of the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
verses.decoded: In the fifty-second year of Azariah, king of Judah, Pekah, the son of Remaliah, began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned for twenty years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD; he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.kjv: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
verses.decoded: During the reign of Pekah, king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, came and captured Ijon, Abel-beth-maachah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee—all the land of Naphtali—and took them captive to Assyria.

verses.kjv: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.decoded: Hoshea, the son of Elah, made a plot against Pekah, the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and became king in his place during the twentieth year of Jotham, the son of Uzziah.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.decoded: The rest of the actions of Pekah and everything he did are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

verses.kjv: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.decoded: In the second year of Pekah, the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.decoded: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD; he followed all the ways that his father Uzziah had done.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: However, the high places were not taken away; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense at the high places. He built the upper gate of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other things that Jotham did, and everything he accomplished, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: In those days the Lord began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
verses.decoded: During that time, the LORD started to send Rezin, the king of Syria, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah, against Judah.

verses.kjv: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Jotham died and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David, his father. Then his son Ahaz became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
verses.decoded: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord his God, like David his father.
verses.decoded: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD his God, like David his father did.

verses.kjv: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: But he followed the ways of the kings of Israel, and he even made his son go through fire, following the detestable practices of the nations that the LORD had driven out from before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.decoded: He offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.kjv: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
verses.decoded: Then Rezin, king of Syria, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to fight. They surrounded Ahaz, but they could not defeat him.

verses.kjv: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.decoded: At that time Rezin, king of Syria, took back Elath for Syria and forced the Jews out of Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath and lived there up to this day.

verses.kjv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
verses.decoded: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, saying, I am your servant and your son: come up and rescue me from the power of the king of Syria and from the power of the king of Israel, who are attacking me.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Ahaz took the silver and gold that were found in the house of the LORD and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent them as a gift to the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria listened to him because the king of Assyria attacked Damascus, captured it, took its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

verses.kjv: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
verses.decoded: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, and saw an altar there. King Ahaz sent the design of the altar and its pattern, including all its workmanship, to Urijah the priest.

verses.kjv: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
verses.decoded: And Urijah the priest built an altar following all the instructions that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus; so Urijah the priest made it before King Ahaz returned from Damascus.

verses.kjv: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
verses.decoded: When the king returned from Damascus, he saw the altar. The king went to the altar and made an offering on it.

verses.kjv: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
verses.decoded: He burned his burnt offering and his grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

verses.kjv: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the Lord, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the Lord, and put it on the north side of the altar.
verses.decoded: He also took the bronze altar that was in front of the LORD, from the front of the temple, from between the altar and the temple of the LORD, and placed it on the north side of the altar.

verses.kjv: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to inquire by.
verses.decoded: And King Ahaz told Urijah the priest, saying, On the large altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening grain offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his grain offering, along with the burnt offerings of all the people of the land, and their grain offerings, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offerings and all the blood of the sacrifices; and the bronze altar will be for me to seek guidance from.

verses.kjv: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
verses.decoded: Urijah the priest did exactly as King Ahaz commanded.

verses.kjv: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
verses.decoded: King Ahaz cut off the edges of the bases and removed the basin from them; he took down the large basin from the bronze oxen beneath it and placed it on a floor made of stones.
