verses.kjv: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the Lord for the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: He removed the shelter for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entrance outside, from the house of the LORD to use for the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other things that Ahaz did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Ahaz died and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David, and his son Hezekiah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.decoded: In the twelfth year of Ahaz, king of Judah, Hoshea, the son of Elah, began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who ruled before him.

verses.kjv: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.decoded: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, came against him; and Hoshea became his servant and gave him gifts.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was plotting against him because Hoshea had sent messengers to So, the king of Egypt, and did not bring a tribute to the king of Assyria as he had done every year. Therefore, the king of Assyria arrested Hoshea and put him in prison.

verses.kjv: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Assyria advanced through the entire land, went up to Samaria, and laid siege to it for three years.

verses.kjv: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.decoded: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria, took the people of Israel into Assyria, and settled them in Halah, in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

verses.kjv: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.decoded: This happened because the people of Israel sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, away from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and they worshiped other gods,

verses.kjv: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.decoded: And they followed the laws of the nations that the LORD had driven out from before the people of Israel, and the laws of the kings of Israel, which those kings had established.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the Lord their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel secretly did things that were wrong against the LORD their God, and they built high places in all their cities, from the watchtower to the fortified city.

verses.kjv: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.decoded: They placed idols and wooden symbols on every high hill and under every green tree.

verses.kjv: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the Lord carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the Lord to anger:
verses.decoded: And there they burned incense on all the high places, just like the nations the LORD had taken away before them; and they did evil things to make the LORD angry:

verses.kjv: For they served idols, whereof the Lord had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
verses.decoded: Because they worshiped idols, which the LORD had told them not to do.

verses.kjv: Yet the Lord testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.decoded: But the LORD warned Israel and Judah through all the prophets and all the seers, saying, Turn away from your evil ways, and obey my commandments and my laws, following all the law that I commanded your ancestors, which I sent to you through my servants the prophets.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the Lord their God.
verses.decoded: However, they refused to listen and made their necks stiff, just like the stubbornness of their ancestors who did not believe in the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the Lord had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.decoded: They rejected his laws, and the agreement he made with their ancestors, and the warnings he gave them; they followed worthless things, became empty, and went after the nations around them, about whom the LORD had commanded them not to act like them.

verses.kjv: And they left all the commandments of the Lord their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.decoded: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God, made molten images, including two calves, created a sacred grove, worshiped all the heavenly bodies, and served Baal.

verses.kjv: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.decoded: They made their sons and daughters go through fire, practiced fortune-telling and magic, and committed themselves to doing evil in the eyes of the LORD, to make Him angry.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.decoded: So the LORD was very angry with Israel and took them away from his presence; only the tribe of Judah remained.

verses.kjv: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the Lord their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.decoded: Also, Judah did not keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but followed the laws of Israel that they had made.

verses.kjv: And the Lord rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.decoded: The LORD rejected all the descendants of Israel, caused them suffering, and handed them over to their enemies, until he removed them from his presence.

verses.kjv: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the Lord, and made them sin a great sin.
verses.decoded: Because he separated Israel from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat king. Jeroboam caused Israel to stop following the LORD and led them to commit a great sin.

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
verses.decoded: Because the people of Israel followed all the sins that Jeroboam committed; they did not turn away from them;

verses.kjv: Until the Lord removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
verses.decoded: Until the LORD took Israel away from his presence, just as he had said through all his servants the prophets. So Israel was taken from their own land to Assyria and remains there to this day.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Ava, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and settled them in the cities of Samaria instead of the Israelites. They took control of Samaria and lived in its cities.

verses.kjv: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the Lord: therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
verses.decoded: At the start of their living there, they did not respect the LORD; so the LORD sent lions among them, and the lions killed some of them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
verses.decoded: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations you have removed and placed in the cities of Samaria do not know how to respect the God of this land; so he has sent lions among them, and look, they kill them because they do not know how to respect the God of the land.

verses.kjv: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
verses.decoded: Then the king of Assyria gave the order, saying, Take one of the priests you brought from there; let him go and live there, and let him teach the people the way of the God of that land.

verses.kjv: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear the Lord.
verses.decoded: Then one of the priests whom they had taken away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should respect and worship the LORD.

verses.kjv: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
verses.decoded: However, each nation made their own gods and placed them in the temples on the high places that the Samaritans had built, each nation in the cities where they lived.

verses.kjv: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.decoded: The people from Babylon made Succoth-benoth, the people from Cuth made Nergal, and the people from Hamath made Ashima,

verses.kjv: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.decoded: The Avites worshiped Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burned their children in fire as offerings to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.kjv: So they feared the Lord, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.decoded: So they respected the LORD and appointed some of the least important among them as priests of the high places, who offered sacrifices for them in the temples of the high places.

verses.kjv: They feared the Lord, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
verses.decoded: They respected the LORD, but they also worshiped their own gods, just like the nations from which they had been taken away.

verses.kjv: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the Lord, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the Lord commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
verses.decoded: Up to this day, they continue to live in the same old ways: they do not respect the LORD, nor do they follow their laws, their rules, or the law and commands that the LORD gave to the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

verses.kjv: With whom the Lord had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
verses.decoded: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and commanded them saying, You shall not fear other gods, nor bow down to them, nor serve them, nor offer sacrifices to them:

verses.kjv: But the Lord, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
verses.decoded: But the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt with great power and an outstretched arm, you shall fear him, and you shall worship him, and to him you shall offer sacrifices.

verses.kjv: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
verses.decoded: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever; and you shall not fear other gods.

verses.kjv: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
verses.decoded: And you must not forget the agreement I have made with you; you must not be afraid of other gods.

verses.kjv: But the Lord your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
verses.decoded: But you shall fear the LORD your God; and he will rescue you from the power of all your enemies.

verses.kjv: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
verses.decoded: However, they did not listen, but they continued to act as they had done before.

verses.kjv: So these nations feared the Lord, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
verses.decoded: So these nations feared the LORD, and they also worshiped their carved idols, both their children and their grandchildren; just as their ancestors did, they continue to do the same up to this day.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
verses.decoded: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah, king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz, king of Judah, began to reign.

verses.kjv: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
verses.decoded: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father did.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just like his father David did.

verses.kjv: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
verses.decoded: He took away the high places, destroyed the idols, cut down the sacred trees, and smashed the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because the Israelites were still burning incense to it at that time. He named it Nehushtan.

verses.kjv: He trusted in the Lord God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.
verses.decoded: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him there was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any who were before him.

verses.kjv: For he clave to the Lord, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: Because he remained faithful to the LORD and did not stop following him, but obeyed his commandments, which the LORD gave to Moses.

verses.kjv: And the Lord was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
verses.decoded: The LORD was with him, and he succeeded wherever he went. He rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.

verses.kjv: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.decoded: He defeated the Philistines all the way to Gaza and its surrounding areas, from the watchtower to the fortified city.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
verses.decoded: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah, king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria attacked Samaria and laid siege to it.

verses.kjv: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
verses.decoded: And after three years they captured it: in the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was captured.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria took Israel away to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

verses.kjv: Because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
verses.decoded: Because they did not obey the voice of the LORD their God, but broke his covenant and all that Moses, the servant of the LORD, commanded, and they did not listen to or follow them.

verses.kjv: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.decoded: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah, king of Judah, sent a message to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, "I have wronged you; please withdraw from me. I will pay whatever you demand from me." The king of Assyria assigned to Hezekiah, king of Judah, three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king’s house.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD and in the king’s treasury.

verses.kjv: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: At that time, Hezekiah removed the gold from the doors of the LORD's temple and from the pillars that Hezekiah, king of Judah, had covered with gold, and he gave it to the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a large army against Jerusalem. They went up and arrived at Jerusalem. When they arrived, they came and stood by the water channel of the upper pool, which is on the road to the fuller’s field.

verses.kjv: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
verses.decoded: When they called the king, Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the household, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.

verses.kjv: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.decoded: And Rab-shakeh said to them, Now speak to Hezekiah, This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What confidence is this that you trust in?

verses.kjv: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.decoded: You say, (but these are just empty words,) I have advice and strength for the war. Now who do you trust that you are rebelling against me?

verses.kjv: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
verses.decoded: Now, look, you are trusting in the support of this broken reed, which is Egypt, and if someone leans on it, it will pierce their hand and stab them. That is how Pharaoh king of Egypt is to everyone who trusts in him.

verses.kjv: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the Lord our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
verses.decoded: But if you say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: isn't he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, and who has told Judah and Jerusalem, You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.decoded: So now, I ask you, give guarantees to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you can put riders on them.

verses.kjv: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.decoded: How then will you reject the authority of one commander of the least important servants of my master, and trust in Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

verses.kjv: Am I now come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.decoded: Have I come up against this place without the LORD to destroy it? The LORD told me, Go up against this land and destroy it.

verses.kjv: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.decoded: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah said to Rab-shakeh, Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, because we understand it. Do not speak to us in the Jewish language where the people on the wall can hear.

verses.kjv: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.decoded: But Rab-shakeh said to them, Has my master sent me to your master and to you to say these things? Has he not sent me to the men who are on the wall so they can eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?

verses.kjv: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
verses.decoded: Then Rab-shakeh stood and shouted loudly in the Jewish language, saying, Listen to the message from the great king, the king of Assyria:

verses.kjv: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
verses.decoded: The king says, Do not let Hezekiah fool you, because he will not be able to rescue you from my power.

verses.kjv: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Do not let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD by saying, 'The LORD will definitely save us, and this city will not be handed over to the king of Assyria.'

verses.kjv: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
verses.decoded: Do not listen to Hezekiah, because this is what the king of Assyria says: Make a deal with me by giving a gift, and come out to me, and then each of you can eat from your own vine, and each of you from your own fig tree, and each of you can drink the water from your own cistern.

verses.kjv: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The Lord will deliver us.
verses.decoded: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive oil and honey, so that you may live and not die; do not listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you by saying, 'The LORD will save us.'

verses.kjv: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.decoded: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered their land from the power of the king of Assyria?

verses.kjv: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
verses.decoded: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? Have they rescued Samaria from my hand?

verses.kjv: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
verses.decoded: Who are they among all the gods of the nations that have saved their countries from my power, that the LORD should save Jerusalem from my power?

verses.kjv: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.decoded: But the people remained silent and did not answer him at all, because the king had commanded, saying, Do not answer him.

verses.kjv: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.
verses.decoded: Then Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.decoded: He sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the household, and Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests, wearing sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.decoded: And they said to him, This is what Hezekiah says, Today is a day of trouble, of punishment, and of insult: because the children have reached the time to be born, but there is no strength to give birth.

verses.kjv: It may be the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.
verses.decoded: It is possible that the LORD your God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria, his master, has sent to insult the living God; and will correct the words that the LORD your God has heard. Therefore, lift up your prayer for the remaining people who are left.

verses.kjv: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.decoded: Then the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah.

verses.kjv: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.decoded: And Isaiah said to them, Say this to your master, This is what the LORD says, Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have insulted me.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.decoded: Look, I will send a sudden disaster against him, and he will hear a report and go back to his own country; and I will make him die by the sword in his own country.

verses.kjv: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.decoded: So Rab-shakeh returned and found the king of Assyria fighting against Libnah because he had heard that the king had left Lachish.

verses.kjv: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,
verses.decoded: And when he heard that Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, had come out to fight against him, he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: This is what you will say to Hezekiah, king of Judah: Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying, 'Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.'

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.decoded: Look, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries by completely destroying them: and will you be saved?

verses.kjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
verses.decoded: Have the gods of the nations saved those whom my ancestors destroyed, such as Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden who were in Thelasar?

verses.kjv: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?
verses.decoded: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the house of the LORD and laid the letter out before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah prayed before the Lord, and said, O Lord God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.decoded: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD and said, O LORD God of Israel, who lives between the cherubim, you are the God, yes, you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: you have made heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: Lord, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, Lord, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.
verses.decoded: LORD, listen carefully and hear: LORD, open your eyes and see: and listen to the words of Sennacherib, who has sent him to insult the living God.

verses.kjv: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
verses.decoded: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

verses.kjv: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.decoded: And they have thrown their gods into the fire because they were not gods, but the work of human hands, made of wood and stone; so they destroyed them.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O Lord our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord God, even thou only.
verses.decoded: So now, Lord our God, I ask you, please save us from his power, so that all the kingdoms of the earth will know that you are the Lord God, you alone.

verses.kjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
verses.decoded: Then Isaiah, the son of Amoz, sent a message to Hezekiah, saying, This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I have heard the prayer you made to me about Sennacherib, king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.decoded: This is the message that the LORD has spoken about him: The young woman, the daughter of Zion, has looked down on you and laughed at you with contempt; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

verses.kjv: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Who have you insulted and spoken against? And against whom have you raised your voice and looked up to the heights? It is against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.
verses.decoded: Through your messengers you have insulted the Lord and said, With the many chariots I have come up to the top of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedar trees and its best fir trees; and I will enter the fortified places of its borders and into the forest of its Carmel.

verses.kjv: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
verses.decoded: I have dug and drunk unfamiliar waters, and with the soles of my feet I have dried up all the rivers of places under siege.

verses.kjv: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.decoded: Have you not heard long ago how I have done it, and from ancient times that I have formed it? Now I have made it happen, so that you would destroy fortified cities into ruined heaps.

verses.kjv: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the people living there were weak, they were frightened and confused; they were like the grass of the field, and like the green plants, like the grass on the rooftops, and like grain that is destroyed before it grows up.

verses.kjv: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.decoded: But I know where you live, and when you leave and come back, and your anger against me.

verses.kjv: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.decoded: Because your anger against me and your noisy uproar have reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back the way you came.

verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
verses.decoded: And this will be a sign to you: You will eat what grows naturally this year, and in the second year you will eat what grows from that; and in the third year you will sow, reap, plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

verses.kjv: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
verses.decoded: The small group that has survived from the house of Judah will grow roots deep into the ground and produce fruit above.

verses.kjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
verses.decoded: A small group will come out of Jerusalem, and those who survive from Mount Zion; the passionate commitment of the LORD of hosts will make this happen.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria: He will not enter this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with a shield, nor build a ramp against it.

verses.kjv: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: The way he came, he will return the same way, and he will not enter this city, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.decoded: For I will protect this city and save it for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.decoded: That night, the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 soldiers in the Assyrian camp. When they got up early the next morning, they were all dead bodies.

verses.kjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.decoded: So Sennacherib, king of Assyria, left, traveled, came back, and lived in Nineveh.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: It happened that while he was worshiping in the temple of Nisroch his god, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with the sword. Then they escaped to the land of Armenia. After that, his son Esar-haddon became king in his place.

verses.kjv: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.decoded: At that time, Hezekiah was very sick and close to death. The prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz, came to him and said, "This is what the LORD says: Get your affairs in order, because you will die and not live."

verses.kjv: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the Lord, saying,
verses.decoded: Then he turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: I beseech thee, O Lord, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.decoded: I beg you, LORD, please remember now how I have lived before you honestly and with a sincere heart, and have done what is good in your eyes. And Hezekiah cried very much.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.decoded: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle courtyard, the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.kjv: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Go back and tell Hezekiah, the leader of my people, This is what the LORD, the God of David your father, says: I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; look, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.decoded: And I will add fifteen years to your life; and I will rescue you and this city from the power of the king of Assyria; and I will protect this city for my own sake, and for the sake of my servant David.

verses.kjv: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
verses.decoded: And Isaiah said, Take a bunch of figs. They took it and put it on the sore, and he got better.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the Lord the third day?
verses.decoded: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I will go up to the house of the LORD on the third day?

verses.kjv: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the Lord, that the Lord will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?
verses.decoded: And Isaiah said, This is the sign you will receive from the LORD, that the LORD will do what he has promised: will the shadow move forward ten degrees, or will it move back ten degrees?

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
verses.decoded: And Hezekiah replied, It is a small matter for the shadow to go down ten steps; no, let the shadow go back ten steps.

verses.kjv: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the Lord: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
verses.decoded: And Isaiah the prophet prayed to the LORD, and he caused the shadow on the sundial of Ahaz to move back ten degrees, which it had previously moved down.

verses.kjv: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.decoded: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah because he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.decoded: And Hezekiah listened to them and showed them all the treasures in his house, the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious ointment, all the weapons in his armory, and everything found in his storehouses. There was nothing in his house or in all his kingdom that Hezekiah did not show them.

verses.kjv: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.
verses.decoded: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and asked him, What did these men say? And where did they come from to you? And Hezekiah said, They have come from a distant country, even from Babylon.

verses.kjv: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.decoded: And he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, They have seen everything in my house: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.

verses.kjv: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Listen to the message from the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Look, the time will come when everything in your house and everything your ancestors have stored up until today will be taken to Babylon; nothing will be left, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: And some of your sons who will come from you, whom you will father, they will take away; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?
verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, The word of the LORD that you have spoken is good. And he said, Isn't it good if there is peace and truth during my lifetime?

verses.kjv: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other events of Hezekiah's reign, all his achievements, how he built a pool and a tunnel to bring water into the city, are these not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah died and was buried with his ancestors, and his son Manasseh became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.
verses.decoded: Manasseh was twelve years old when he started to rule, and he ruled for fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the detestable practices of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.decoded: He rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he set up altars for Baal, made a sacred grove like Ahab king of Israel did; and he worshiped all the heavenly bodies and served them.

verses.kjv: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
verses.decoded: He built altars in the house of the LORD, where the LORD said, 'I will put my name in Jerusalem.'

verses.kjv: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: He built altars for all the heavenly armies in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.
verses.decoded: He caused his son to go through fire, practiced divination, used spells, and consulted with spirits and sorcerers. He did many evil things in the sight of the LORD, to make Him angry.

verses.kjv: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
verses.decoded: He placed a carved image of the wooden idol that he had made inside the temple, about which the LORD said to David and to Solomon his son, 'In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.'

verses.kjv: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
verses.decoded: I will no longer cause the people of Israel to leave the land I gave to their ancestors, as long as they carefully obey everything I have commanded them and follow all the laws that my servant Moses gave them.

verses.kjv: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: But they did not listen, and Manasseh led them to do more evil than the nations that the LORD destroyed before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke through his servants the prophets, saying,

verses.kjv: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
verses.decoded: Because Manasseh, king of Judah, has committed these terrible acts, and has done more evil than all the Amorites who lived before him, and has caused Judah to sin by worshiping his idols:

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
verses.decoded: Therefore, this is what the LORD God of Israel says: Look, I am bringing such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that anyone who hears about it will have their ears burn with shock.

verses.kjv: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
verses.decoded: And I will extend over Jerusalem the measuring line of Samaria and the plumb line of the house of Ahab; and I will wipe out Jerusalem like a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

verses.kjv: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
verses.decoded: And I will abandon the remaining part of my inheritance and hand them over to their enemies; they will become a victim and loot for all their enemies;

verses.kjv: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
verses.decoded: Because they have done what was evil in my eyes and have made me angry, from the day their ancestors came out of Egypt until now.

verses.kjv: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Also, Manasseh killed a great deal of innocent people, filling Jerusalem with blood from one end to the other; in addition to his sin that caused Judah to sin by doing what was evil in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other actions of Manasseh, everything he did, and the sins he committed, are they not recorded in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: Manasseh died and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza. His son Amon became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.decoded: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz from Jotbah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh did.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Manasseh did.

verses.kjv: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
verses.decoded: He followed exactly the same path as his father, served the same idols his father served, and worshiped them.

verses.kjv: And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.
verses.decoded: He abandoned the LORD God of his ancestors and did not follow the LORD's path.

verses.kjv: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
verses.decoded: The servants of Amon planned against him and killed the king in his own house.

verses.kjv: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.decoded: The people of the land killed everyone who had plotted against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah, his son, king instead of him.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other things that Amon did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
verses.decoded: Josiah was eight years old when he began to rule, and he ruled for thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah from Boscath.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.decoded: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, followed all the ways of David his father, and did not turn to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying,
verses.decoded: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah's reign, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, who was the son of Meshullam and the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
verses.decoded: Go to Hilkiah the high priest so that he can count the silver that has been brought into the house of the LORD, which the gatekeepers have collected from the people.

verses.kjv: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the Lord, to repair the breaches of the house,
verses.decoded: And let them give it to the workers who are in charge of the house of the LORD, and let them give it to the workers who are in the house of the LORD, to repair the damages of the house,

verses.kjv: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
verses.decoded: To carpenters, builders, and masons, and to buy wood and cut stone to repair the house.

verses.kjv: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
verses.decoded: However, no accounting was made to them for the money that was given into their hands, because they acted faithfully.

verses.kjv: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.decoded: And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

verses.kjv: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king and reported to the king, saying, Your servants have collected the money that was found in the temple, and have given it to those who are responsible for the work and oversee the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.decoded: And Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book. And Shaphan read it to the king.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.decoded: It happened that when the king heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
verses.decoded: The king gave orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Achbor son of Michaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king, saying,

verses.kjv: Go ye, inquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
verses.decoded: Go, ask the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, about the words of this book that has been found, because the LORD's anger is very strong against us, since our ancestors did not listen to the words of this book and did not do everything written about us.

verses.kjv: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
verses.decoded: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asahiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum, the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, who was the keeper of the wardrobe; (she lived in Jerusalem in the college;) and they spoke with her.

verses.kjv: And she said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
verses.decoded: And she said to them, This is what the LORD God of Israel says, Tell the man who sent you to me,

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, Look, I will bring disaster on this place and on its people, exactly as all the words of the book that the king of Judah has read.

verses.kjv: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
verses.decoded: Because they have abandoned me and have burned incense to other gods to make me angry with all the things they have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be put out.

verses.kjv: But to the king of Judah which sent you to inquire of the Lord, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;
verses.decoded: But to the king of Judah who sent you to ask the LORD, say this to him: This is what the LORD God of Israel says about the words you have heard;

verses.kjv: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I said against this place and against its people—that they would become a desolation and a curse—and you tore your clothes and wept before me; I have also heard you, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
verses.decoded: So now, I will take you to be with your ancestors, and you will be buried peacefully; your eyes will not see all the disaster I will bring on this place. Then they reported this message to the king again.

verses.kjv: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: The king sent for and gathered all the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem to come to him.

verses.kjv: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The king went into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the people living in Jerusalem went with him, along with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both young and old. He read aloud to them all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
verses.decoded: The king stood by a pillar and made a promise before the LORD to follow the LORD and to obey his commandments, his testimonies, and his laws with all his heart and all his soul, to carry out the words of this promise that were written in this book. All the people agreed to the promise.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.
verses.decoded: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests of the second rank, and the gatekeepers to take out of the temple of the LORD all the objects made for Baal, for the wooden idols, and for all the heavenly bodies. Then he burned them outside Jerusalem in the Kidron Valley fields and took their ashes to Bethel.

verses.kjv: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
verses.decoded: He removed the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed to burn incense on the high places in the cities of Judah and in the areas around Jerusalem; also those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the stars, and to all the heavenly bodies.

verses.kjv: And he brought out the grove from the house of the Lord, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
verses.decoded: He took the wooden idol out of the house of the LORD, outside Jerusalem, to the Kidron Valley, and burned it there, crushed it into powder, and scattered the powder over the graves of the people’s children.

verses.kjv: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the grove.
verses.decoded: And he destroyed the houses of the male cult prostitutes that were near the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the pagan shrine.

verses.kjv: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.
verses.decoded: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah and made unclean the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba. He also tore down the high places at the gates near the entrance of the gate of Joshua, the governor of the city, which were on the left side of a man at the city gate.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
verses.decoded: However, the priests serving at the high places did not go up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they ate the unleavened bread with their fellow priests.

verses.kjv: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
verses.decoded: He made Topheth, located in the valley of the children of Hinnom, unclean so that no one could burn their son or daughter as an offering to Molech.

verses.kjv: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
verses.decoded: He removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun at the entrance of the house of the LORD, near the room of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the outskirts, and he burned the chariots dedicated to the sun with fire.

verses.kjv: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
verses.decoded: The king destroyed the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had built, and the altars that Manasseh had built in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD. He broke them down from there and threw their dust into the Kidron brook.

verses.kjv: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
verses.decoded: And the high places that were in front of Jerusalem, which were on the right side of the Mount of Corruption, which Solomon, the king of Israel, had built for Ashtoreth, the detestable idol of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh, the detestable idol of the Moabites, and for Milcom, the detestable idol of the people of Ammon, the king made unclean.

verses.kjv: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
verses.decoded: He smashed the idols, cut down the sacred trees, and filled their places with human bones.

verses.kjv: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.
verses.decoded: Also, the altar that was at Bethel and the high place that Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin, had made—he broke down both the altar and the high place, burned the high place, crushed it to powder, and burned the sacred tree.

verses.kjv: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
verses.decoded: As Josiah turned around, he saw the tombs on the mountain. He sent people to take the bones out of the tombs, and they burned the bones on the altar, defiling it, just as the LORD had said through the man of God who had spoken these words.

verses.kjv: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.
verses.decoded: Then he said, What is this inscription that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and announced these things you have done against the altar of Bethel.

verses.kjv: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
verses.decoded: And he said, Leave him alone; do not let anyone move his bones. So they left his bones alone, along with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.

verses.kjv: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.
verses.decoded: Josiah also removed all the buildings of the high places in the cities of Samaria that the kings of Israel had built to make the LORD angry, and he treated them the same way he had done in Bethel.

verses.kjv: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He killed all the priests of the high places who were there at the altars, burned human bones on the altars, and then returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the Lord your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.
verses.decoded: The king told all the people, "Celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, just as it is written in the book of this agreement."

verses.kjv: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
verses.decoded: Certainly, there had not been a Passover celebration like this since the time of the judges who led Israel, nor during all the reigns of the kings of Israel, nor the kings of Judah.

verses.kjv: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah's reign, this Passover was celebrated to the LORD in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Also, Josiah removed the people who practiced spiritism, the magicians, the carved images, the idols, and all the detestable things that were found in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, so that he could obey the words of the law that were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.

verses.kjv: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
verses.decoded: There was no king like him before who turned to the LORD with all his heart, all his soul, and all his strength, following all the law of Moses; and after him, no one like him arose.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
verses.decoded: However, the LORD did not turn away from the intensity of his great anger, which was kindled against Judah because of all the provocations that Manasseh had caused him.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
verses.decoded: The LORD said, I will also remove Judah from my presence, just as I removed Israel, and I will reject this city Jerusalem, which I chose, and the temple where I said, My name will be there.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: Now the rest of the actions of Josiah, and everything he did, are they not written in the book of the records of the kings of Judah?

verses.kjv: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
verses.decoded: During his reign, Pharaoh-nechoh, king of Egypt, went up to fight against the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River. King Josiah went out to meet him, and when he saw him, he was killed at Megiddo.

verses.kjv: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.
verses.decoded: His servants carried his dead body in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, anointed him, and made him king in place of his father.

verses.kjv: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.decoded: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like all his ancestors had done.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
verses.decoded: Pharaoh-nechoh put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he could not rule in Jerusalem; and he imposed a tax on the land of one hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
