verses.decoded: Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim, the son of Josiah, king instead of his father Josiah, changed his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away; Jehoahaz went to Egypt and died there.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.
verses.decoded: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh, but he imposed taxes on the land to provide the money as Pharaoh commanded. He collected silver and gold from the people of the land, each according to his tax assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necho.

verses.kjv: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
verses.decoded: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like all his ancestors had done.

verses.kjv: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
verses.decoded: During his reign, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, invaded, and Jehoiakim served him for three years; then he turned against him and rebelled.

verses.kjv: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servants the prophets.
verses.decoded: And the LORD sent groups of Chaldeans, groups of Syrians, groups of Moabites, and groups of the people of Ammon against him, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, just as the LORD had spoken through his servants the prophets.

verses.kjv: Surely at the commandment of the Lord came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
verses.decoded: Certainly, this happened to Judah because of the LORD's command, to remove them from his presence, because of the sins of Manasseh, according to everything he did;

verses.kjv: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.
verses.decoded: And also because of the innocent blood that he shed: he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not forgive.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.decoded: The other events of Jehoiakim's reign and everything he did are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah, aren't they?

verses.kjv: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: So Jehoiakim died and was buried with his ancestors, and his son Jehoiachin became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
verses.decoded: And the king of Egypt did not come out of his land again, because the king of Babylon had taken everything that belonged to the king of Egypt from the Nile River to the Euphrates River.

verses.kjv: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he started to rule, and he ruled in Jerusalem for three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like everything his father had done.

verses.kjv: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
verses.decoded: At that time, the officials of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came against Jerusalem, and the city was surrounded.

verses.kjv: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
verses.decoded: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came to attack the city, and his servants surrounded it.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
verses.decoded: Jehoiachin, the king of Judah, went to the king of Babylon, along with his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers. The king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

verses.kjv: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.
verses.decoded: He took away all the treasures from the house of the LORD, and the treasures from the king's house, and broke into pieces all the gold vessels that Solomon, king of Israel, had made in the temple of the LORD, just as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
verses.decoded: He took away all of Jerusalem, including all the leaders, all the brave warriors, ten thousand captives, and all the skilled workers and metalworkers; no one was left except the poorest people in the land.

verses.kjv: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.decoded: He took Jehoiachin to Babylon, along with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officials, and the important people of the land; he took them captive from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
verses.decoded: And all the strong men, seven thousand of them, along with one thousand craftsmen and smiths, all who were strong and skilled for war, the king of Babylon took captive to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon appointed Mattaniah, his father's brother, as king instead of him, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

verses.kjv: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
verses.decoded: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

verses.kjv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.decoded: He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD, just like everything Jehoiakim had done.

verses.kjv: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: Because of the LORD's anger, it happened in Jerusalem and Judah that until he had removed them from his presence, Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
verses.decoded: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came with all his army against Jerusalem and camped against it; they built forts all around it.

verses.kjv: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
verses.decoded: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.kjv: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
verses.decoded: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, and there was no bread for the people living in the land.

verses.kjv: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.
verses.decoded: The city was broken open, and all the soldiers escaped at night through the gate between two walls, which is near the king’s garden. The Chaldeans were surrounding the city all around, and the king went toward the plain.

verses.kjv: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
verses.decoded: The army of the Chaldeans chased after the king and caught up with him in the plains of Jericho, and all his soldiers ran away from him.

verses.kjv: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
verses.decoded: So they captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

verses.kjv: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
verses.decoded: They killed the sons of Zedekiah in front of him, then they blinded Zedekiah, bound him with bronze chains, and took him to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: In the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzar-adan, the captain of the guard and servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.
verses.decoded: He burned the house of the LORD, the king’s palace, all the houses in Jerusalem, and every important man's house with fire.

verses.kjv: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
verses.decoded: And the entire army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls all around Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.
verses.decoded: Now the remaining people who were left in the city, and the fugitives who escaped to the king of Babylon, along with the rest of the crowd, were taken away by Nebuzar-adan, the captain of the guard.

verses.kjv: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
verses.decoded: But the captain of the guard left some of the poor people of the land to work as vineyard workers and farmers.

verses.kjv: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
verses.decoded: The Chaldeans broke into pieces the bronze pillars that were in the house of the LORD, along with the bases and the bronze basin that was in the house of the LORD, and they carried the bronze from them to Babylon.

verses.kjv: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
verses.decoded: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the bronze vessels they used for their service.

verses.kjv: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
verses.decoded: The captain of the guard took away the firepans, the bowls, and all items made of gold, keeping the gold items in gold and the silver items in silver.

verses.kjv: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
verses.decoded: The two pillars, one large basin, and the stands that Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the bronze of all these items was very heavy.

verses.kjv: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
verses.decoded: The height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the top part on it was made of brass; the height of the top part was three cubits; and there was twisted decoration and pomegranates all around the top part, all made of brass; and the second pillar was like these, with twisted decoration.

verses.kjv: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
verses.decoded: The captain of the guard arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:
verses.decoded: And from the city he took an officer who was in charge of the soldiers, and five men who were in the king’s presence and were found in the city, and the chief scribe of the army who registered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city:

verses.kjv: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
verses.decoded: Nebuzar-adan, the captain of the guard, took these people and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

verses.kjv: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
verses.decoded: The king of Babylon attacked them and killed them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. Then the people of Judah were taken away from their land.

verses.kjv: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
verses.decoded: As for the people who stayed in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, had left behind, he appointed Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as their governor.

verses.kjv: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
verses.decoded: When all the army commanders, along with their men, heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Careah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of a Maachathite, along with their men, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

verses.kjv: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
verses.decoded: And Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, Do not be afraid to be servants of the Chaldeans: live in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and things will go well for you.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
verses.decoded: But it happened in the seventh month that Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, from the royal family, came with ten men and killed Gedaliah so that he died, along with the Jews and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.

verses.kjv: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
verses.decoded: All the people, both ordinary and important, and the army leaders, got up and went to Egypt because they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
verses.decoded: It happened in the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin, king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, that Evil-merodach, king of Babylon, in the year he began to reign, released Jehoiachin, king of Judah, from prison;

verses.kjv: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;
verses.decoded: And he spoke kindly to him, and placed his throne above the thrones of the kings who were with him in Babylon;

verses.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: And they changed his prison clothes; and he ate bread in front of the king every day for the rest of his life.

verses.kjv: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
verses.decoded: And his allowance was a regular allowance given to him by the king, a daily amount for every day, for all the days of his life.
